note: Rustic Chequamegon National Forest campground on a wooded point in the Mondeaux Flowage, with the Ice Age Trail running through it. Some sites are over 45 ft long and some have lake access. The Picnic Point site nearby is tent-only. No generators during quiet hours (10 pm-6 am). --Claude
summary: USFS page + rec.gov info listing + closure order read. 15 back-in sites, no hookups, 2 vault toilets, water, FCFS only, $15, May 1-Oct 15 ('Site Closed' banner = off season). Rec.gov listing is information-only. WATERFRONT: stored lakefront rests on an aggregator; sites are under continuous canopy -> lakefront to lakeview recommended. Pin, phone and website OK.
flags: WATERFRONT: stored 'lakefront' -> recommend 'lakeview'. The stored evidence is wisconsintrailguide (an aggregator: sites 6 and 10 'only steps away from the water'). The USFS says only 'Some sites have lake access' and rec.gov 'Shady sites are nestled along the Mondeaux Flowage'. On Esri imagery the whole campground (around 45.3177,-90.4381) is under continuous hardwood canopy with no site on open ground at the water. Sites 6 and 10 may sit within ~50 m of the flowage, but under canopy that is a view, not lakefront. No official site map found to place them.

STATUS: the USFS page shows a 'Site Closed' banner on 2026-11-17 - consistent with the posted season (May 1-Oct 15), not a long-term closure. The forest's only emergency closure order (09-13-04-26-04, to 2027-09-01) covers Perkinstown Motorized Trail 326A, not West Point.

SITES: USFS says 15 sites ('13 accessible campsites' in its prose); rec.gov says 'a dozen'. 15 written from the USFS count. Most sites are back-in and 'not specifically designed for RVs', but some are over 45 ft long - fits a 23-ft rig.
REC.GOV: facility 249596 exists but is information-only (no campsites to book; notice 'First-come, first-served sites are available') - booking stays reservable false, fcfs always.
PHONE: 715-748-4875 confirmed (Medford office). WEBSITE live - keep.
